## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Related issue

Link related issue(s), or write "Not applicable".

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / maintenance
- [ ] Build or configuration
- [ ] Other

## Scope

- Product or area:
- Main files or components changed:
- User-visible behavior changed:

## Testing

- [ ] I reviewed the diff for unrelated changes.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests or checks.
- [ ] I tested on the intended device or environment where applicable.
- [ ] I documented checks that could not be run.

**Environment and commands/checks:**

Describe exactly what was tested and the result. Do not claim tests passed if they were not run.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No passwords, tokens, private keys, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Permissions, file access, and data handling were considered where relevant.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes follow the SYNTRA Security Policy.
- [ ] This change does not introduce unreviewed data collection or telemetry.

## Risks and limitations

Describe compatibility risks, migrations, known defects, or limitations. Write "None known" only if you have reviewed them.

## Screenshots or evidence

Add sanitized screenshots or test evidence when useful. Remove private paths and personal information.

## Maintainer checklist

- [ ] Requirements and acceptance criteria are clear.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated where needed.
- [ ] Review is complete.
- [ ] Release notes or follow-up tasks are identified where needed.
